packages: >-
              -p codex-model-provider-info -p codex-shell-escalation
              -p codex-linux-sandbox -p codex-hepta-memory
              -p codex-exec-server -p codex-hepta-supervisor
              -p codex-hepta-memory-extension
          - owner: core
            packages: -p codex-core -p codex-mcp -p core_test_support
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact source commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind source identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git diff --check
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell-framework-records"
      - name: Install native build prerequisites
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential clang cmake protobuf-compiler libssl-dev libcap-dev pkg-config bubblewrap
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@44c6d64aa62cd779e873306675c7a58e86d6d532
        with:
          tool: just@1.51.0,nextest@0.9.103
      - uses: facebook/install-dotslash@1e4e7b3e07eaca387acb98f1d4720e0bee8dbb6a
      - name: Expose DotSlash for existing owner tests
        run: sudo install -m 0755 "$(command -v dotslash)" /usr/local/bin/dotslash
      - name: Prepare the original checksum-verified Zsh test resource
        if: matrix.owner == 'core'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 300 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell-framework-records/zsh-resource.json" \
            -- dotslash -- fetch "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/codex-rs/app-server/tests/suite/zsh"
      - name: Resolve repository-verified V8 artifacts

semantics: The existing unit-returning initialize wrapper delegates to initialize_with_client_info using exactly DEFAULT_CLIENT_NAME, title None and version0.1.0. The fixture now calls that existing returning helper directly under the same timeout, retaining the actual JSONRPC response variant, decoding and process_indeterminate assertion. The shared helper still supplies the same capabilities, request ID verification and initialized acknowledgment. Production and helper APIs are untouched.
ci: Append one app-server owner lane and extend only the existing Zsh prefetch condition. The same original app-server Zsh descriptor was already selected in the prefetch body; all four existing lanes and other commands, profiles, timeouts and retries remain unchanged.
